messages:
Leah Kim: Thanks for joining the strategy rundown. Quick live thread for follow-ups and clarifications.
Asha Patel: Two quick Qs: what's the single most important metric for this quarter? p95 latency, $/1M tokens, or new ARR?
Leah Kim: Short version: reliability/SLA first, then unit cost for hosted, then PLG activation metrics. We'll post the OKRs this afternoon.
Diego Ramos: For product priorities, should infra teams push Optimize (auto-batching/quant) or accelerate Dedicated expansion for enterprise deals?
Leah Kim: Optimize gives faster margin wins and helps hosted customers immediately. Dedicated is our long-term enterprise expansion lever. Sequence: Optimize -> Dedicated scale -> Private.
Maya Chen: On positioning vs big cloud providers: keep "production-first" messaging or lean harder into "cost-optimized inference" for infra teams?
Leah Kim: Keep production-first as the umbrella. Separate collateral will highlight cost/routing/fallbacks for platform buyers.
Chris Lowe: Can we get a 1-pager with persona snippets + top KPIs for sales (p95 target, $/1M tokens, MTTI)?
Leah Kim: Yes — @Chris I'll draft a 1-pager and share in #product-marketing in 48h.
Asha Patel: Example of "fallbacks" in practice? region + model-variant or other patterns?
Leah Kim: Example: primary model rlx-1 in us-west; fallback rlx-1-q (quantized) in eu-central; policy: local variant -> remote variant -> lower-cost tier. Diagram coming.
Diego Ramos: Any immediate pricing changes for Dedicated with Series C goals?
Leah Kim: No price changes now. Experimenting with burst blocks and a 3-tier reserved commit pilot next month.
Maya Chen: Rollout guardrails (canary %, auto-fallback) — when do eng teams need to adopt hooks?
Leah Kim: Guardrails land in June; we'll publish a small runbook and required hooks.
allhands-bot: Slides and recording: https://redwood.slides/all-hands/1769009999
Leah Kim: I'll share the OKR doc and a short Q&A by EOD tomorrow. Thanks for the questions, keep them here for follow-up.
